europe_now.title: Curfews Imposed Across France Following Severe Civil Unrest
europe_now.summary: The French government has implemented curfews in Paris and other cities to curb ongoing rioting, looting, and public disorder connected to rising fuel prices. Authorities report that the emergency measures helped maintain relative calm overnight, though security forces remain on high alert.

sources.headline: France protests: Govt to impose new curfews where 'situation requires it'
French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says

europe_now.title: Deadly Floods Impact Eastern Spain After Heavy Rainfall
europe_now.summary: Torrential downpours have triggered severe flooding across eastern regions of Spain, resulting in multiple fatalities. Emergency response teams are actively dealing with the aftermath as large areas remain inundated.

sources.headline: Spain floods kill four as torrential rain inundates eastern regions

top_stories.title: French Unrest and Security Measures
top_stories.summary: France has introduced emergency curfews across multiple cities following a weekend of extensive rioting, looting, and arson. Prime Minister reports indicate that the restrictions successfully restored overnight order as officials grapple with public safety and political fallout.

sources.headline: France protests: Govt to impose new curfews where 'situation requires it'
French cities calm overnight after curfews imposed to quell violence, PM says

top_stories.title: Severe Weather and Fatal Floods in Spain
top_stories.summary: Intense torrential rainfall has struck eastern Spain, causing deadly floods that have claimed at least four lives. Emergency services continue to respond to widespread damage as communities face severe weather disruptions.

sources.headline: Spain floods kill four as torrential rain inundates eastern regions
